body:
## HDR-03 Production deployment receipt — 23 October 2026

**LIVE:** Reviewed HDR-03 Web `main` commit `c19bc6e8017552653ab5c59caaad7335873ff0bb` was deployed on Vercel as `dpl_EGXC6Z4mhqNeoxBHwwuJgHmEKf8S`; Vercel reports **READY** with `fairswap.in` and `www.fairswap.in` aliases. The approved source PR #237 is merged. All four source-branch CI flows (2 Web, 2 Backend) passed; post-merge Web main CI run [#40000960338](https://github.com/vivek2310sharma/FairSwap-Web/actions/runs/40000960338) was still running at initial deployment verification.

**Backend-first:** Backend release source PR #49 was merged as `24ed66196d8402fbfc0aa80f4f47abd943a61447`. FairSwapProd `kriuhwppxgxsyyrbjsau` now has the reviewed HDR-03 SQL, `public.get_unread_counts()` and owner-only `public.unread_count_signals` installed. Migration ledger is **58**, with exactly one new row `20261023160752_hdr03_production_unread_counts`. The operator installed the reviewed release SQL in a **single transaction**, added a same-transaction security postflight and exact history receipt because the connected MCP migration action generates a different version automatically. This was a manually orchestrated SQL transaction **not** CLI `db push` or MCP `apply_migration`, and no fake applied versions were recorded. Pre-existing 57 history preserved. Standalone READ ONLY postflight and read-only authenticated database-role count/RLS smoke passed; no new HDR-03 security advisor findings.

**Owner-approved release waivers:** The owner explicitly waived backup/restore rehearsal and elected to conduct the *genuine* two-user Auth/WebSocket/Realtime acceptance **in Production after release**. These gates are deferred/waived **NOT PASSED**. No recovery point was independently tested. Web access through an external page-fetch service could not be confirmed; Vercel deployment state and alias ownership are verified.

**Production owner acceptance checklist (do not share passwords or private records):**
1. Separate genuine A/B accounts in two isolated profiles: sign in and verify guest/member mobile header and bottom navigation, including low-bandwidth.
2. B sends A a clearly marked synthetic message in a permitted conversation. A unread chat badge must increase **without page reload**; B must not see A's unread signal.
3. A opens the conversation; badge decreases. Also check A's outgoing reply after earlier unread B→A (read cursor to latest displayed).
4. Notification read and mark-all-read update own badge; never show the other user's notifications.
5. Two tabs, refresh, reconnect after network interruption, background/foreground; verify real Realtime row-event delivery, not just subscription success.
6. A→B same-tab account switch and sign-out discard previous account's private SSR content, notifications and badges.
7. Test public contact, grievance, safety and Help Centre links without signing in.
8. Record PASS/FAIL and UTC times with redacted evidence. Synthetic chats **have no UI delete** and may persist; avoid payment links, fabricated transactions, fake listings and personal data, and agree any clean-up before creating fixtures.

**Branch retention:** Keep Web `release/hdr-03-main-20261023` and Backend `release/hdr-03-prod-20261023` until post-merge CI and owner acceptance are complete. Any cross-user data leak is a release incident: stop testing, assess immediate Web rollback and independently reviewed Backend containment forward migration. GitHub tasks remain with ChatGPT.
